text: Asset relinks and science (lead, 2026-10-04): a relink is 'no rerun' today only because no analysis reads stimulus pixels or geometry. Once any analysis consumes stimulus content, relinks become science inputs: the relinked file's digest must enter the science digest and make dependent runs stale. Provenance must show each relink's digest now, so a repaired file that differs from the lost original is visible.
